# Dr. Johannes Otterbach

> Physicist and engineer (Palantir, Rigetti, OpenAI, Merantix, nyonic) investing in deep tech. Technical due diligence, advisory, and keynotes for AI and quantum.

Johannes Otterbach is a physicist, engineer, and investor based in Berlin. He holds a PhD in quantum physics, built software, quantum, and AI systems at Palantir, Rigetti Computing, and OpenAI, led ML research at Merantix, co-founded nyonic as CTO, and now invests in and advises deep-tech companies. He races long-distance triathlon (Ironman, Xtreme) and trail.

## Pages
- [Home](https://johannesotterbach.com/): overview
- [Advisory](https://johannesotterbach.com/advisory/): I help investors and founders in AI and quantum see what the technology can really do, how defensible it is, and where it creates real value for customers.
- [About](https://johannesotterbach.com/about/): career, endurance racing, highlights of podcasts, talks, and papers
- [Publications, talks & media](https://johannesotterbach.com/publications/): all papers, patents, talks, podcasts, and press


## Advisory
- Technical due diligence (for VC funds, M&A, and deal teams): From a single expert call to a full review. Does the technology hold up, can it be defended, and how does it carry the business?
- Advisory & angel investing (for founders, seed to Series B): A sparring partner on technical strategy, team and org design, hiring, and pivots, from someone who has been a CTO. As an advisor, an angel investor, or both.
- Keynotes & panels (for summits, offsites, and LP meetings): Keynotes with Q&A, panels, and moderation. Topics: frontier AI, compute sovereignty in Europe, and where quantum computing really stands.
- First step: Whether it's a single expert call or a full review, it starts the same way.
- Contact: via the contact link on any page; provider details in the [imprint](https://johannesotterbach.com/imprint/).

## Career
- 2011: PhD in quantum physics, RPTU Kaiserslautern
- 2011–2014: Postdoc, Harvard Quantum Optics Center
- 2014–2015: Palantir, Software engineer
- 2015–2017: LendUp, Data scientist
- 2017–2018: Rigetti Computing, Quantum engineer
- 2018–2021: OpenAI, Researcher
- 2021–2023: Merantix, VP of ML Research
- 2023–2024: nyonic, Co-founder & CTO
- Now: SPRIND & angel investor, Deep-tech venture investing
